desc:
💻 Welcome to Warnetopia!

Become the owner of a cyber cafe and develop your business into the city's most popular hangout spot! Arrange every corner of the room, serve customers, and manage your income.

🖥️ Buy PCs, upgrade your internet, and expand your internet cafe.
🎨 Arrange tables, chairs, posters, and decorations according to your style.
🍜 Cook and deliver food orders to customers.
🕹️ Add arcade machines for extra income.
👥 Recruit cashiers, cleaning staff, technicians, and servers.
🔧 Fix broken PCs and keep the internet cafe clean.
🏙️ Explore the city, help residents, and collect rare cards!

🏘️ Play with up to 6 players, each with their own color!
💾 Progress is saved automatically.
📱 Can be played on mobile phones, tablets, and PCs.

Ready to become a cybercafe boss? Open the doors and welcome your first customers!
